name: specstream
description: SpecStream is the live web data engine for teams and agents. The Search API answers a question from the live web, $5 per 1,000 searches. The Extract API reads up to 20 web pages, PDF, Word and Excel files a call, $0.80 per 1,000 pages. Deep Search finds every match on the live web as structured rows and monitors them for change. Every value carries its source URL and read time. The plugin is free to install. Use of the SpecStream API is billed under SpecStream's terms, and Deep Search shows the most a run can cost before it runs.

SPECSTREAM_API_KEY.title: API key
SPECSTREAM_API_KEY.description: Create one under Agents & API in your SpecStream workspace. Keep it in this setting, never in a prompt or a commit. Paid work still needs your approval of the price.
